name: mobile-gameplay-ux-review
description: Review mobile web gameplay through playtesting and actionable UX findings.

interface.shortDescription: Review touch controls and mobile gameplay UX.
interface.longDescription: Compare desktop and mobile gameplay with Playwright, then produce a prioritized report with evidence and acceptance criteria for implementation.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $mobile-gameplay-ux-review to playtest this web game on mobile and produce mobile-gameplay-review.md with prioritized findings and acceptance criteria.
